name: University of British Columbia
header:
University of British Columbia
Canada · Mathematics MSc; exceptional direct-entry PhD / later PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 40. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Affiliated scholarship deadline is 22 days before the admission deadline.
• Admission submission triggers referee invitations: entering names alone is insufficient.
• CAD 40,000 PhD minimum is not an MSc funding promise.
• Faculty list focuses on the requested algebraic/complex/arithmetic areas; other number theory/adjacent
faculty include Lior Silberman, Jozsef Solymosi and Nahid Walji, whose recent paper dossiers remain to be
checked.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Four-year mathematics bachelor's; US-institution junior/senior GPA at least 3.3/4.0. MSc is the normal
bachelor's route. Direct PhD requires departmental nomination and first-class honours or the specified
qualifying master's study/research record; not automatically eligible. [s1]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Create CWL account; select degree; identify supervisors; obtain scans of registrar-issued transcripts and
referee institutional addresses. Applications opened 1 October 2026. [s1] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Encouraged, and name possible supervisors. Prior commitment is not required; an eventual offer depends on
faculty selection. [s1] [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
CWL/application portal; post-submission uploads until document deadline. New uploads do not overwrite old
files: rename clearly. [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Admission/deadline pages and Affiliated award instructions explicitly cover 2027 entry. Faculty availability and
2027 MSc funding offer remain individualized. [s2] [s7]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Testing applies to study outside Canada where English is not the principal instructional language; tests valid 24
months. If required: IELTS 7.0, with R/L/S 7.0 and W 6.5; TOEFL new scale 5.0 overall (R/L 5.0, W/S 4.5). [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Inference from the instructional-language rule: a completed UChicago English-medium degree satisfies the
exemption; citizenship/F-1 alone does not determine this. Confirm any portal evidence request. [s1]
GRE General [Standing rule]
GRE not required; source does not distinguish optional consideration from non-consideration. [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE not required; no distinct mandatory Mathematics Subject test listed. Optional score treatment is
unverified. [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two letters; institutional referee emails required. [s1]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
Affiliated Master's needs two separate signed assessment forms, not merely admission letters. Proposed
supervisor cannot assess unless a current/former supervisor. [s8] [s22]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Invitation is sent when the online admission application is submitted, not just when referee details are entered.
[s4]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: submit early enough to give referees time before 31 December. [s2] [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
References tab shows status; referee sees submission confirmation. [s4]

Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Each referee can be replaced once before deadline; reminders/email corrections allowed. Referee can request
reopening via graduate.apply@ubc.ca before deadline. Cross-application letter reuse not established. [s4]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required resume/CV upload. Public page gives no page limit, detailed prompt, or formatting rules. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required research-interest statement serves this purpose; no separately named SOP in checklist. Public
length/format not specified. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background statement on public checklist; any additional portal prompt remains
unverified. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required uploaded statement of research interests (exact short label). Elaborated prompt, length and
formatting are not published. Identify preferred supervisors in application. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No standalone admission proposal specified. Affiliated Master's scholarship does require one; see scholarship
field. [s1] [s8]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Explicitly not required. Optional upload or link permission is not established. [s1]
Publications list [Unresolved]
Separate publication list/paper upload not required in public checklist; include appropriate citations within CV,
subject to portal instructions. [s1]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separately named writing item in public checklist; confirm supplemental portal questions. [s1]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
Affiliated Master's: application form, lay project summary, relevant sex/gender questions, criteria-based award
selection; Canadian Common CV (CGRS-M template) PDF; proposal 1 page plus 1 bibliography page. Prompt
paraphrase: project background, objectives, theoretical methods and significance. Letter paper, 12 pt Times
New Roman, single spacing, at most 6 lines/inch, margins >=0.75 inch, black text, no hyperlinks. Submit to
math program; confirm email/file method. All transcripts and two signed confidential assessments accompany
it. [s8]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No other admission writing item identified in public checklist. Scholarship form details should be checked in the
linked current template before drafting. [s1] [s8]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
University PhD minimum CAD 40,000 annually in first four years from September 2026; applies to international
students. This is a package that can include work/awards, not a net stipend or an MSc guarantee. Math page
has no verified total MSc annual guarantee. [s6]
Years of support [Standing rule]
PhD minimum four years. Math tuition-fee award states first four PhD years. MSc duration/total guarantee must
be obtained from offer. [s5] [s6]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
PhD minimum includes international students; TAs and Affiliated awards also available internationally.
Affiliated Master's values CAD 175-16,000, competitive. [s5] [s6] [s7]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Package may combine TA/RA and awards. Full TA normally 12 hours/week; tuition/fees not generally waived
through TA. RA amounts depend on grant and performance. [s5] [s6]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
PhD tuition award automatic after registration. TA forms obtained from department. Affiliated Master's requires
separate early application. [s5] [s7]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Affiliated awards, department entrance awards, grant-supported RA and TA. Do not rely on the math page's old
federal award amounts or immigration/tax descriptions as current guidance. [s5] [s7]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International graduate application CAD 168.25; nonrefundable. Standing fee subject to change. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Automatic only if citizenship AND correspondence address satisfy UBC's UN least-developed-country rule.
Residence in Chicago ordinarily fails the address condition; confirm citizenship if applicable. [s4]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Jim Bryan
Enumerative geometry, Calabi-Yau threefolds, Donaldson-Thomas and Gromov-Witten invariants. [s9] [s11]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Gopakumar-Vafa Invariants for Local Calabi-Yau Orbifolds of A_N-type
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Zinovy Reichstein
Algebraic groups, Galois cohomology, essential dimension and Brauer classes. [s9] [s14]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Brauer classes not split by genus 1 curves
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Dragos Ghioca
Arithmetic dynamics, semiabelian varieties, Mordell-Lang and positive characteristic. [s10] [s15]

Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Intersection of orbits for polynomials in characteristic p
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Kai Behrend
Derived algebraic and differential geometry, algebraic stacks, L-infinity spaces and moduli/Donaldson-Thomas
theory. [s9] [s19] [qa1]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 publication · On the structure of étale fibrations of L-infinity-bundles
With Hsuan-Yi Liao and Ping Xu; published 30 December 2025. Publisher page confirms UBC affiliation and derived
differential-geometric subject.
Kalle Karu
Toric and birational geometry, logarithmic geometry, Cox rings and the commutative algebra/Hodge theory of
fans and simplicial spheres. [s9] [s18] [qa2]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 publication · Differential operators, anisotropy, and simplicial spheres
With Matt Larson and Alan Stapledon; IMRN 2026(13), rnag147, published 6 July 2026. Publisher and author preprint records
cross-checked; old UBC bibliography alone was incomplete.
Representation theory
Sabin Cautis
Categorification, coherent sheaves, Coulomb branches and geometric representation theory. [s9] [s12]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: undated on official list · Canonical bases for Coulomb branches of 4d N=2 gauge theories
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Julia Gordon
p-adic harmonic analysis, motivic integration and Harish-Chandra characters. [s10] [s13]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2023 preprint · Integrability and singularities of Harish-Chandra characters
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Rachel Ollivier
Mod-p representations of p-adic groups and Hecke algebras. [s10] [s16]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · On the center of the generic affine Hecke algebra
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Number theory
Michael Bennett
Diophantine equations, rational approximation and arithmetic of elliptic curves. [s10] [s17]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 · Effective S-unit equations beyond three terms
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.

Sujatha Ramdorai
Iwasawa theory, Selmer groups, Galois representations/deformation theory, with earlier work on quadratic
forms and motives. [s10] [s20] [qa3]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 publication · Massey products and the Iwasawa theory of fine Selmer groups
With Anwesh Ray; Canadian Journal of Mathematics First View, 16 October 2026. Publisher confirms UBC affiliation.
Vinayak Vatsal
Automorphic forms, toric periods, half-integral weight modular forms, p-adic families and Iwasawa theory. [s10]
[s21] [qa4]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2023 publication · Toric Periods and p-adic Families of Modular Forms of Half-Integral Weight
AMS Memoirs 289, no.1438 (September 2023). Publisher abstract and institutional library record checked. This is the newest
publication verified in this follow-up, not a claim that no later paper exists.

University of British Columbia
Canada · Mathematics MSc; exceptional direct-entry PhD / later PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 40. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Affiliated scholarship deadline is 22 days before the admission deadline.
• Admission submission triggers referee invitations: entering names alone is insufficient.
• CAD 40,000 PhD minimum is not an MSc funding promise.
• Faculty list focuses on the requested algebraic/complex/arithmetic areas; other number theory/adjacent
faculty include Lior Silberman, Jozsef Solymosi and Nahid Walji, whose recent paper dossiers remain to be
checked.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Four-year mathematics bachelor's; US-institution junior/senior GPA at least 3.3/4.0. MSc is the normal
bachelor's route. Direct PhD requires departmental nomination and first-class honours or the specified
qualifying master's study/research record; not automatically eligible. [s1]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Create CWL account; select degree; identify supervisors; obtain scans of registrar-issued transcripts and
referee institutional addresses. Applications opened 1 October 2026. [s1] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Encouraged, and name possible supervisors. Prior commitment is not required; an eventual offer depends on
faculty selection. [s1] [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
CWL/application portal; post-submission uploads until document deadline. New uploads do not overwrite old
files: rename clearly. [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Admission/deadline pages and Affiliated award instructions explicitly cover 2027 entry. Faculty availability and
2027 MSc funding offer remain individualized. [s2] [s7]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
23 December 2026 for September 2027. Published pages do not specify cutoff time/zone. [s2]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Affiliated Master's: 1 December 2026 before 5:00 pm Pacific, earlier than admission. Separate ordinary
math-funding cutoff not stated. [s7]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
Admission references: 31 December 2026 (time/zone unstated). Scholarship references: 1 December 2026
before 5:00 pm Pacific. [s2] [s7] [s8]

Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
All supporting documents due 31 December 2026; no separate test-score grace period published. UChicago
English-medium degree normally avoids English testing. [s3]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
31 December 2026; includes transcripts and all supporting documents. [s3]
Accepting an offer [2027 confirmed]
Accept by 15 April 2027; offers remain valid until then. [s3]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Testing applies to study outside Canada where English is not the principal instructional language; tests valid 24
months. If required: IELTS 7.0, with R/L/S 7.0 and W 6.5; TOEFL new scale 5.0 overall (R/L 5.0, W/S 4.5). [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Inference from the instructional-language rule: a completed UChicago English-medium degree satisfies the
exemption; citizenship/F-1 alone does not determine this. Confirm any portal evidence request. [s1]
GRE General [Standing rule]
GRE not required; source does not distinguish optional consideration from non-consideration. [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE not required; no distinct mandatory Mathematics Subject test listed. Optional score treatment is
unverified. [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload PDF scans of official transcripts from every post-secondary institution, grading keys and degree
certificates, in English. Registrar copies sent directly only after offer. [s1]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate course-list upload specified in public required-materials list; portal-specific fields unverified. [s1]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No separate descriptions required by public checklist. Core preparation: real/complex analysis, abstract
algebra, and another advanced area. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two letters; institutional referee emails required. [s1]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
Affiliated Master's needs two separate signed assessment forms, not merely admission letters. Proposed
supervisor cannot assess unless a current/former supervisor. [s8] [s22]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Invitation is sent when the online admission application is submitted, not just when referee details are entered.
[s4]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: submit early enough to give referees time before 31 December. [s2] [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
References tab shows status; referee sees submission confirmation. [s4]

Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Each referee can be replaced once before deadline; reminders/email corrections allowed. Referee can request
reopening via graduate.apply@ubc.ca before deadline. Cross-application letter reuse not established. [s4]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required resume/CV upload. Public page gives no page limit, detailed prompt, or formatting rules. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required research-interest statement serves this purpose; no separately named SOP in checklist. Public
length/format not specified. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background statement on public checklist; any additional portal prompt remains
unverified. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required uploaded statement of research interests (exact short label). Elaborated prompt, length and
formatting are not published. Identify preferred supervisors in application. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No standalone admission proposal specified. Affiliated Master's scholarship does require one; see scholarship
field. [s1] [s8]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Explicitly not required. Optional upload or link permission is not established. [s1]
Publications list [Unresolved]
Separate publication list/paper upload not required in public checklist; include appropriate citations within CV,
subject to portal instructions. [s1]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separately named writing item in public checklist; confirm supplemental portal questions. [s1]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
Affiliated Master's: application form, lay project summary, relevant sex/gender questions, criteria-based award
selection; Canadian Common CV (CGRS-M template) PDF; proposal 1 page plus 1 bibliography page. Prompt
paraphrase: project background, objectives, theoretical methods and significance. Letter paper, 12 pt Times
New Roman, single spacing, at most 6 lines/inch, margins >=0.75 inch, black text, no hyperlinks. Submit to
math program; confirm email/file method. All transcripts and two signed confidential assessments accompany
it. [s8]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No other admission writing item identified in public checklist. Scholarship form details should be checked in the
linked current template before drafting. [s1] [s8]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
University PhD minimum CAD 40,000 annually in first four years from September 2026; applies to international
students. This is a package that can include work/awards, not a net stipend or an MSc guarantee. Math page
has no verified total MSc annual guarantee. [s6]
Years of support [Standing rule]
PhD minimum four years. Math tuition-fee award states first four PhD years. MSc duration/total guarantee must
be obtained from offer. [s5] [s6]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
PhD minimum includes international students; TAs and Affiliated awards also available internationally.
Affiliated Master's values CAD 175-16,000, competitive. [s5] [s6] [s7]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Package may combine TA/RA and awards. Full TA normally 12 hours/week; tuition/fees not generally waived
through TA. RA amounts depend on grant and performance. [s5] [s6]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
PhD tuition award automatic after registration. TA forms obtained from department. Affiliated Master's requires
separate early application. [s5] [s7]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Affiliated awards, department entrance awards, grant-supported RA and TA. Do not rely on the math page's old
federal award amounts or immigration/tax descriptions as current guidance. [s5] [s7]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International graduate application CAD 168.25; nonrefundable. Standing fee subject to change. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Automatic only if citizenship AND correspondence address satisfy UBC's UN least-developed-country rule.
Residence in Chicago ordinarily fails the address condition; confirm citizenship if applicable. [s4]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Search-cached scholarship page showed 2025 dates, but opened official page and 2027-28 PDF confirm 1
December 2026. Math funding page contains historical NSERC amounts; use current university PhD policy. [s5]

individual 2027 supervision availability still requires confirmation. [s1] [s19] [s20] [s21]
